description: The Kerala High Court has stayed the payment of any annuity amount for the installation and operation of the Artificial Intelligence camera units on different roads of the State as part of the Safe Kerala project
body_lead: The Kerala High Court has stayed the payment of any annuity amount for the installation and operation of the Artificial Intelligence camera units on different roads of the State as part of the Safe Kerala project. No payments shall be made without informing the court or obtaining the prior approval of the court, directed a Division Bench of the court headed by Chief Justice S. V. Bhatti on Tuesday. The court issued notices to the respondents in the case before admitting the petitions moved by Opposition Leader V D Satheesan and former Opposition Leader Ramesh Chennithala.
